status_note: Breakpoint/resume MATCH: the locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle (real universalAction -> resetDefaults -> getCurrent tree plus scripted probe trees driven through the real setBreakPoint/getSubAction/getSubRule/perform/printState/clearBreakPoints) and Rugra's ported breakpoint machinery (real set_default_actions tree plus the same scripted probes) produce byte-identical 52-line observations covering name-path addressing with ambiguous duplicates, rule paths, set/clear bit landings, real-tree break_start stop/continue at the mainloop and stackstall heads with resume-equals-single equality, the leaf/group tmp+persistent breakpoint matrix, and a rule-level break_action interrupting and resuming a real ActionPool mid-pass with identical per-rule totals. Registered non-observed domains remain in coverage as UNTESTED and are bound to their residual TODO ids.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: perform/setBreakPoint operate on the shared per-Action members (status/count/lcount/count_tests/count_apply/breakpoint); Ghidra mutates them in place on the Action*/Rule* resolved by getSubAction/getSubRule, Rugra on the externalized ActionState slots held by the parent container or driver (plus the pool-side rule_breakpoints/rule_tests/rule_applies parallel vectors). ActionGroup::apply advances the protected state iterator in place (++state before the -1 return).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: perform's do-while((lcount<count)&&rule_repeatapply) with the switch fall-through: status_start checks the start break BEFORE count_tests += 1; breakstarthit resumes into apply without re-checking the break or re-incrementing tests; actionbreak does not reapply; ActionGroup::apply walks list begin()->end() and resumes at ++state after a group actionbreak; ActionPool::apply walks beginOpAll()->endOpAll() with rule_index < perop[opc].size(), keeping op_state/rule_index across an interrupted apply; getSubAction/getSubRule descend child lists in registration order with matchcount>1 resolving to failure.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: count resets only at status_start and accumulates across an interrupted/resumed run (the pool keeps the interrupted carry internally and returns it with the resumed pass so the externalized total matches the oracle count member at completion); count_tests increments only on unbroken status_start entries; count_apply increments when lcount<count and before the action-break check; tmpbreak bits are cleared when hit (one-shot); per-rule count_tests increments before applyOp and count_apply after a positive return.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No sorting anywhere: name paths match by exact string equality (name==token, ruleName==remain); ambiguity (two matches) resolves to failure exactly as action.cc:475-476/806-808; per-op rule dispatch follows registration order; the only normalization is the documented underscore deletion for rule-name/spec projections, injective on both sides' name sets.

analysis_options.real_tree: ActionDatabase::universalAction -> resetDefaults -> getCurrent (architecture.cc:582-591 production derivation); breakpoints set from the universal root and the resolved fullloop/stackstall subtrees driven through Action::perform (getSubAction's Action* equivalents)
analysis_options.real_tree_break_start: break_start on universal:fullloop:mainloop observed at the fullloop subtree head, and on universal:fullloop:mainloop:stackstall resumed to completion and compared against a fresh single run (ActionStart and the unbounded followFlow head are outside the driven subtrees; the fixture architecture has no loader)
analysis_options.scripted_trees: ScriptedAction/ProbeGroup control only apply() changes; perform/setBreakPoint/getSubAction/getSubRule/apply plumbing are the real locked implementations. Case D drives a real ActionPool (rule_repeatapply) with a CountingRule over two synthetic COPY ops
analysis_options.initialization: FixtureArchitecture/FixtureTranslate (spaces: constant/other/unique/ram/register/stack/join/iop); shell Funcdata built through Scope::addFunction -> FunctionSymbol::getFunction (localmap attached by the Funcdata constructor); no loader, no SLEIGH
analysis_options.rule_names: Rule names printed underscore-normalized (Rugra names rules in snake_case, the oracle without underscores, e.g. mult_neg_one vs multnegone); normalization is injective on both name sets (pool_purity_1204 precedent)
analysis_options.pool_resume_observation: ActionPool::op_state/rule_index are default-private in the oracle header; the pool resume position is observed behaviorally through the rule's per-attempt/per-application trace with op addresses, identical projection on both sides
analysis_options.warnings: rule_warnings_on absent in every case; issueWarning emission is not exercised
analysis_options.normalization: None besides the documented rule-name/spec underscore deletion; one fixed-order line stream and a final newline compared byte-for-byte
